changes.text: 俄国此前出兵占了伊犁；左宗棠请与俄议还伊犁，朝廷诏遣全权大臣崇厚使俄，谈成一份条约。崇厚为朝士所纠，议了很久，议不出结果。作者的一种解释是：难处不在于要不要伊犁，而在于约已经签了；认账，是失地失利权在先；翻案，得有人去谈，还得有让对方重新坐下来的筹码。

Russia had earlier sent troops in and seized Ili. Zuo Zongtang asked that the return of Ili be negotiated with Russia, and the court sent Chong Hou, a plenipotentiary envoy, to Russia, where he concluded a treaty. Chong Hou was censured by court officials, and the debate dragged on toward no conclusion. One reading, the author's, is that the trouble was never whether Ili mattered, but that the treaty had already been signed. Accept it, and the lost territory and compromised rights stood as a fait accompli. Repudiate it, and someone had to go back to the table carrying enough leverage to make the other side sit down again.
僵局之中，以西事自任的左宗棠上奏，逐条点出哪几处不可许，主张「先之以議論，委婉而用機，次決之以戰陣，堅忍而求勝」。奏上获嘉许，崇厚得罪去，朝廷命曾纪泽使俄改约；他于是自请出屯哈密。六年四月（原文年号纪年），他「輿櫬發肅州」，五月抵哈密。七月，他奉诏入都备顾问，由西路统兵的锦棠接替。明年正月，和议成，交还伊犁。

Into that deadlock stepped Zuo Zongtang, who had taken the western affairs upon himself, with a memorial. Item by item he named the terms that must not be accepted, and argued that one should "first take the matter up in negotiation, tactful and alert to opportunity, then settle it on the field of battle, patient and set on victory." The throne commended it; Chong Hou was punished and dismissed, and the court sent Zeng Jize to Russia to revise the treaty. Zuo then asked leave to move his headquarters to Hami. In the fourth month of the sixth year (by the reign-year count used in the source) he "set out from Suzhou with a coffin in his carriage," and reached Hami in the fifth month. In the seventh month he was summoned to the capital and Jintang, who led the western column, took his place. In the first month of the following year, peace was concluded and Ili was returned.
先看这份奏疏落在什么样的局面里。传中所称的「帕夏」，能役使回众，通使结援英、俄，购买兵械自备；英人暗中相助，想让他别立一国，用以屏障俄国。这一句只交代英、俄各自插手的背景。俄方则因回众屡扰其边境，出兵逐回，占了伊犁，还说要代取乌鲁木齐。

Start with the situation the memorial landed in. The figure the biography calls the Pasha could command the Muslim population, sent envoys to seek support from Britain and Russia, and bought weapons to arm his own forces. The British backed him quietly, hoping to see him set up a separate state that would stand as a shield against Russia. This line serves only to show how Britain and Russia each had a hand in the region. Russia, for its part, because Muslim raiders repeatedly harassed its border, sent troops to drive them out, seized Ili, and announced that it would go on to take Urumqi on China's behalf.
其时有伊犁之变，朝廷诏左宗棠分兵屯肃州，他遣徐占彪带六千人前往。传中另记一事：俄方与土耳其交战时，左宗棠部下统兵的金顺请求乘虚袭击伊犁，左宗棠不许，说「不可。師不以正，彼有辭矣」。

At the time of the Ili crisis, the court ordered Zuo Zongtang to detach troops to garrison Suzhou, and he sent Xu Zhanbiao with six thousand men. The biography records a separate episode: when Russia was at war with Turkey, Jin Shun, one of the commanders under Zuo, asked to exploit the opening and strike Ili. Zuo refused: "No. If our army does not act from a position of right, we hand them their excuse."
一种解释是，他宁可错过一次乘虚出兵的机会，也不让对方事后找到说辞。至于他当时怎么权衡，本文所据材料只录了这一句，不作推测。

One reading of it is that he would rather let an opening to strike slip by than give the other side a justification to use afterward. As for how he weighed the decision, the material used here gives only this line, and we do not speculate beyond it.

The Russian side laid out three heads of demand: trade, borders, and indemnity. Chong Hou concluded the treaty, and quickly — the history reaches for one blunt word: "Chong Hou hastily concluded the treaty." Chong Hou was then censured by court officials, and the debate went on without decision. The treaty had been signed, yet Chong Hou had been censured and the debate stalled; the whole affair hung in mid-air.
六年四月，左宗棠「輿櫬發肅州」，五月抵哈密。俄方闻王师大出，增兵守伊犁、纳林河，另派兵船在海上出没，用以震撼京师，天津、奉天、山东同时告警。谈判桌之外，两边都在调动。

In the fourth month of the sixth year Zuo set out from Suzhou with a coffin in his carriage, and reached Hami in the fifth. Hearing that the imperial army was moving in force, Russia reinforced Ili and the Nalin River and sent warships cruising off the coast to shake the capital; at the same time Tianjin, Fengtian, and Shandong all raised the alarm. Away from the negotiating table, both sides were moving troops.
七月，朝廷诏宗棠入都备顾问，以锦棠代之。明年正月，和议成，交还伊犁，防海军皆罢。从一道奏疏到一纸和约，中间有曾纪泽使俄改约，也有数次调动、增兵与告警，最后落在文书上。

In the seventh month the court summoned Zuo to the capital as an adviser and put Jintang in his place. In the first month of the following year, peace was concluded, Ili was handed back, and the coastal defenses were stood down. Between one memorial and one treaty lay Zeng Jize's mission to Russia to revise the treaty, as well as several troop movements, reinforcements, and alarms — and in the end it all came to rest on paper.
另一层容易被忽略的是钱粮，不过这是更早西征收复新疆时的事。西征之初，左宗棠请借外债，诏拨款五百万、敕自借外国债五百万；史书说，出塞凡二十月，新疆南北城尽复，是馈运饶给之力。一种解释是，此前西征靠馈运饶给成事，提出「堅忍而求勝」时可以此为凭。本文所据材料未记伊犁对峙时的钱粮，不能把两者写成同一时期。

The layer easily missed is money and grain — though this belongs to the earlier western expedition that recovered Xinjiang. At the outset of that expedition, Zuo asked to borrow from abroad; the court allotted five million and directed him to raise a further five million as a foreign loan. The history says that in twenty months beyond the passes, the cities of northern and southern Xinjiang were all recovered — and that it was the abundance of supply transport that accomplished it. One reading is that the earlier campaign had succeeded on the strength of its supply, and that this record stood behind the call to be "patient and set on victory." The material used here says nothing about supply during the Ili standoff, so the two should not be treated as the same period.

dispositions.rationale: 在 hook.0 首句前补入有据背景：俄国出兵占伊犁，左宗棠请与俄议还伊犁，朝廷遣崇厚使俄。中英同步，ev 补入 E2、E4。

evidence.quote: 並請與俄議還伊犁、交叛人二事
詔遣全權大臣崇厚使俄

dispositions.rationale: 左宗棠首次出现处写作“以西事自任的左宗棠”，锦棠写作“西路统兵的锦棠”，“六年四月”后注明为原文年号纪年。中英同步，ev 补入 E17。

evidence.quote: 錦棠經布魯特游牧為西路

dispositions.rationale: 在“奏上获嘉许”后补入崇厚得罪去、朝廷命曾纪泽使俄改约，使改约交涉出现在出屯与和议成之前，避免读者把出兵读成和议成的原因。中英同步。

evidence.quote: 崇厚得罪去，命曾紀澤使俄，更前約

dispositions.rationale: 改为“传中所称的「帕夏」”，并加一句点明此处只交代英、俄各自插手的背景。中英同步。
金顺首次出现时写明为左宗棠部下统兵者，依据是其在部署中领东路。中英同步，ev 补入 E12。
把“得手的机会”改为“乘虚出兵的机会”，英文改为“an opening to strike”，不再预设偷袭会成功。
删去证据无据的“on the spot”，改为“concluded the treaty, and quickly”，只保留“遽”所含的仓促之意。中文原无对应内容，无需改动。
中文改为“左宗棠「輿櫬發肅州」”，用「」标出逐字原文，与 hook.1 的引法一致。英文同步给出全文，内容不变。
在奏疏到和约之间补入曾纪泽使俄改约这一交涉环节，不再暗示和约仅由奏疏与军事调动促成。中英同步，ev 补入 E11。
写明借款与出塞二十月是更早西征收复新疆时的事。作者推断收窄为：此前西征靠馈运成事，可作提出「堅忍而求勝」时的凭据。同时注明材料未记伊犁对峙时的钱粮，并删去无据的“只是姿态”一句。中英同步。
